channel.title: Past Competitions :: FAU Cyber Security Club
channel.description: A record of competitions and events the club has participated in, along with the repos and write-ups from each one. These are worth browsing. Seeing how past members approached a challenge — what they built, how they structured it, what worked — is genuinely useful if you are gearing up for your own run.

item.title: 2026 Cyber Patriot
item.description: CyberPatriot is the National Youth Cyber Education Program, focused on securing misconfigured systems across Windows and Linux environments against a scoring engine. Repos https://github.com/caol777/findnfix

item.title: 2026 CCDC
item.description: The Collegiate Cyber Defense Competition (CCDC) puts teams in charge of inheriting and defending a live network infrastructure against a professional red team. It is as close to a real incident response scenario as it gets. Repos https://github.com/caol777/CCDC-scripts

item.title: 2026 eMERGE Hackathon — Project Scalpel
item.description: The eMERGE hackathon project centered around a Cowrie honeypot deployment with a hybrid edge AI component, submitted under the name Project Scalpel. Repos https://github.com/RohanDS2024/Emirge https://github.com/caol777/Cowrie-honeypot
